heading: A collection of intimate voice notes for the moments when you need someone to remind you who you are.

items.title: A little love note from me
items.text: To encourage you in your journey of life
items.cover_alt: Green collage artwork with the words Soul at peace

items.title: To remind you why your dreams matter
items.text: This will consist of a loving channeling and affirmations that will activate you immediately into the space of dreams where what you once imagined suddenly begins to become real in your world!
items.cover_alt: A yellow flower held in a hand

items.title: Faith
items.text: When you don’t have nothing this audio will activate you into attracting exactly what you need that will not only uplift your spirit but place you in a better happier timeline. When you don’t have nothing and hope is gone. Have faith.
items.cover_alt: Banana tree seen from below against a bright sky

items.title: Made for you
items.text: This one is tailored uniquely for you. You can email me or telegram me to send me details of what style of voice note you would like me to create for you.
items.cover_alt: A bitten slice of watermelon held up in a hand
